name: qlrisk_frtb_sa_capital
title: FRTB Standardised Approach capital
description: FRTB SA market-risk capital (MAR21-23) for a book: sensitivities-based method (GIRR, CSR, equity, commodity, FX delta, vega and curvature under the low / medium / high correlation scenarios), default risk charge (non-securitisation) and the residual risk add-on, with breakdowns by component and bucket. Map names to buckets (credit_buckets {'ACME': 4}, equity_buckets {'SPX': 12}), ratings for DRC ({'ACME': 'BBB'}) and vol surfaces to underlyings ({'eq_vol': 'SPX'}); unmapped factors are reported. mode='sbm_from_sensitivities' aggregates FRTB sensitivities you supply; mode='drc_from_positions' charges DRC on positions you supply. Trades take the inputs of each product's qlrisk_price_<product> tool (rates in percent, spreads in basis points, maturity as a tenor like 5Y); confidence levels are in percent (99 = 99%). Inputs: trades, mode; the rest (market_data, reporting_currency, curve_currency, credit_buckets, equity_buckets, commodity_buckets, vol_underlyings, ratings, seniority, exotic, other_residual, csr_sector_gamma, include_curvature, frtb_sensitivities, drc_positions) in the optional `advanced` object. Example: {"trades": [{"product": "InterestRateSwap", "trade_id": "IRS-5Y", "maturity": "5Y", "notional": 10000000, "fixed_rate_pct": 4.4, "counterparty_id": "BANK-A"}, {"product": "CorporateBond", "trade_id": "ACME-5Y", "maturity": "5Y", "face_value": 5000000, "coupon_pct": 5, "issuer": "ACME", "counterparty_id": "ACME"}, {"product": "EquityOption", "trade_id": "SPX-P", "maturity": "6M", "notional": 1000000, "ticker": "SPX", "strike": 5000, "option_type": "put", "counterparty_id": "BANK-B"}], "advanced": {"credit_buckets": {"ACME": 4}, "equity_buckets": {"SPX": 12}, "ratings": {"ACME": "BBB"}, "vol_underlyings": {"eq_vol": "SPX"}}} gives FRTB SA capital 1,167,679.58 USD: SBM 949,470.80, DRC 218,208.78, RRAO 0.00; unmapped factors ['DIV.SPX.1Y', 'DIV.SPX.5Y'] on qlrisk's sample market valued 2026-10-09.
